rules.mask: Unmodified phase3_7.pathways.PathwayMask(condition=B4); P-1 Query -> all real Question Keys, additive -inf only in L0/L1.
rules.score: Original complete candidate sequence logP, no EOS; left/right order, one token each; P-1 is the final prompt query, never the appended answer; margin>0 correct, ties wrong.
rules.split: All original Phase3.2 240 distinct images; string question_id order. Primary: exact complement of original Phase3.7 16 image IDs (224); discovery16 and all240 supplementary. No new sampling or output filtering.

bootstrap.strata: none within each explicitly reported cohort/subset

rules.mcnemar: Two-sided exact binomial on discordant pairs; p=min(1,2*sum(comb(b+c,k),k=0..min(b,c))/2**(b+c)); p=1 if no discordance.
rules.primary: Accuracy difference and two-sided exact McNemar in confirmation224; other intervals descriptive, no multiplicity-adjusted claims.
rules.mass: Per-head P-1 softmax mass partition: Image, real Question, actual BOS, remaining valid text. Compare same-image global Full/B4 and separately local native replay at identical actual layer inputs; L1 replay is not global Full.
rules.correctness: No-op all valid-text logits exact; Question decoder states all32 layers and final RMSNorm exact; blocked weights zero, non-target local queries exact; original causal mask and all visual tokens retained; existing ROW_ATOL=.002 unchanged.
rules.scope: Only Full vs B4. No training, decode, KV cache, exit, layer/strength scan or additional dataset. Do not infer joint necessity, text irrelevance or stronger visual fusion from mask definition.
